page.layout: Full-width title block at top, centred: dedication line "Pio & pacisamanti Lectori", then author name "NICOLAUS VEDELIUS S."; below it one column of italic running text with a woodcut initial E; signature mark at the foot right. No margin notes.

p.i: EX non paucorum fratrum aliorumque virorum graviuum[?] et magnorum relatu atque indiciis intellexi; esse quosdam, qui res novas molian-tur in Ecclesiâ & introducere doctrinam Pontificiam conentur de Potestate Magistratus in rebus Ecclesiasticis. Atque ut eo suo fine potiri queant, adornare eos jam libellum in Hollan-diâ brevi committendum prelo, & me hinc inde acerbe tradu-

page.notes: The woodcut initial E is joined to the word "EX". The "&" and "et" signs at the start of lines are printed as a ligatured et-sign; transcribed as &. "graviuum" is uncertain in the scan. The "(?)" in the foot mark is printed as such and is likely a gathering signature sign. The line ending "tradu-" is a fragment and continues on the next page. The "Digitized by Google" banner and edge marks at the right are excluded.
